js/bm.js.reason: Phase 6-8 (unaccepted): decisions follow enabled stages; Claims, Reports (status stage) and Handover (pickup stage) tabs with native operations. Professor UI refinement batch 1 (unaccepted): at most two decision buttons per bar, Request more info, Cancel appointment and Release pickup as text buttons, Reschedule primary once the time has passed, passed time shown as flat status. Batch 3 (owner review): the page is the only scroller on desktop, with a sticky detail column; pickup main row by state, with Appointment and Release sections. Batch 4 (hierarchy and guidance): Pickups wording, Student-matching field labels, labelled descriptions and notes, private-term alignment, specific dialog intros and confirmation hint, clearer empty queue. Stable round 1 (local Stable improvement): search, status filter and page kept in the URL; return to the queue from a public report page; an open changed decision dialog asks before leaving; its note is kept across an ended session. Stable round 3: records sit in purposeful groups (Claimant, Item, Ownership evidence; Verified claimant, Pickup; the public report and its private section); every public photo appears as a thumbnail row; private photos sit inside their clue box; missing values are muted; the approval note is pre-filled with the pickup next step.

js/student.js.reason: Phase 6/7 (unaccepted): claim/withdraw follow the Student stage; pickup details follow the pickup stage; notifications page read-only (read-marking is a separate, unapproved write). Professor UI refinement batch 2 (unaccepted): on phones a group of four or more view tabs (History) becomes one labelled select driving the same buttons. Batch 4: private-term alignment, report form hints and Lost guidance, edit-mode and photo-removal notices, read-only-safe journey notes, clearer closed-reports empty state, View pickup link. Stable round 1 (local Stable improvement): the item Back link returns to the list this tab came from (Explore, History, My Activity, Home or the BM queue) with its page, filters and scroll; My Activity keeps its page; successful submits, withdraw and delete replace the history entry; report and claim forms ask before leaving and keep typed text across an ended session. Port page entrance intent for successful report and claim saves and unread notification links. Stable round 3: the item page shows one status chip with the report type as text and a label-led claim notice; photos fade in; My Activity keeps its current cards until the new ones arrive; claim cards link the title, hide a zero photo count, state the next step after approval, keep the desk details behind a disclosure and say Update claim; each journey step has a short help line.

css/polish.css.reason: Professor UI refinement batch 1 (unaccepted): notification message smaller than its title; text buttons inside decision bars; passed pickup time as flat status text with a clock icon instead of a filled box or chip. Batch 2: square status flags and notes, full-width flag strips, card previews filling their frame on phones, indented numbered lists, long body copy justified from 768px, BM pane height, phone tab select, and a full-length static background layer. Batch 3: BM panes keep natural height (no inner scroll), pickup action sections, full-width equal segmented tabs below 768px, History select up to 767px. Batch 4: --label token and grouped field labels, BM evidence as content, quieter section headings, labelled BM fields, square journey status, compact no-photo strip on phones. Port the 200 ms entrance on existing signed-in surfaces and the Item Detail loading line. Stable round 3 (local Stable polish, owner-reviewed): labels lead their values and missing values are muted, superseding batch 4's value emphasis at the owner's request; one status chip per card with the Lost/Found word leading a date line pinned to the card bottom; a no-photo frame with a calm icon (a strip on phones and the narrow item page); photo fade-in, matching skeletons and dimmed busy grids instead of layout jumps; compact page headings (the page button under the sentence on phones); paired report fields; a near-solid action pill; BM records in groups with floating separators, a floating column line and a centred item-name header; aligned My Activity claim actions; journey help lines. Stable round 4 (owner notes, 1.3.0): below 1000px the Menu opens as a floating panel over the page instead of pushing it down. Batch B: cards float on mouse hover like 3D cards (lift, slight tilt toward the pointer, soft light), transform only; reduced motion keeps the shadow. Batch C: the profile is one WhatsApp-style column (round photo with an Edit overlay and a View/Take/Upload/Remove menu, inline name editing, read-only rows) and the crop dialog is a dark stage with a dimmed circle, +/- zoom and a round save.
